title: GRCh37 sequence at coding regions and chip loci
description: The reference bases themselves: every protein-coding exon, and a 25-base window around each consumer-chip position. Lets the genome view keep zooming past single positions into the sequence, and lets codons be read.

source.name: 1000 Genomes hs37d5 (GRCh37 + rCRS mitochondrion), cut to coding exons and chip loci

citation: Genome Reference Consortium, GRCh37 (hs37d5 assembly, 1000 Genomes Project); exon coordinates from GENCODE
